## Summary
- Fix the offset in catalog.pager.page to use 1-based page numbers, as specified in #57.
- Add regression coverage for the first and subsequent pages, partial final pages, out-of-range pages, oversized page sizes, and empty inputs.

Fixes #57.

## Validation
- Regression tests before the fix: 4 failed, 2 passed.
- `python -m pytest -q` after the fix: 6 passed.

## Notes
- GitHub file-content reads returned empty results; the change was developed and tested against the provided local source files.
args.head: fix/pagination-57
args.title: Fix one-based pagination offset (#57)
